description: This file defines a ContentProvider named DataProvider for an Android application, managing URLs of Picasa featured pictures and their update timestamps using SQLite database. It includes database schema setup, query, insert, bulkInsert, update operations, and URI provider configuration.

classes.name: DataProvider
classes.description: A ContentProvider managing URL data and timestamps for photos, including database setup, query, insert, bulk insert, update, and URI matching logic.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the database helper to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the content provider by creating the database helper.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Handles queries for different data types based on URI match, returning Cursor objects.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns MIME type based on the URI matched.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new row into the database for URL modification timestamps.

methods.name: bulkInsert
methods.description: Performs bulk insertion of multiple URL entries, clearing existing data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates URL timestamp entries based on provided values and selection.

inner_classes.name: DataProviderHelper
inner_classes.description: SQLiteOpenHelper subclass managing database creation and upgrades/downgrades.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Upgrades database schema, dropping and recreating tables.

methods.name: onDowngrade
methods.description: Downgrades database schema, dropping and recreating tables.
